image_workflow.title: Image workflow
image_workflow.add_image_hint: Upload or paste an image artifact on the canvas.
image_workflow.add_workflow_hint: Connect notes, references, and a live Codex to a native generation flow.
image_workflow.running_hint: Codex is using its native ImageGen tool
image_workflow.native_tool_help: The connected Codex uses image_gen.imagegen from its authenticated session. Orkestrai never asks for or stores an image API key.
image_workflow.account_requirement: Requires an authenticated Codex account or plan with ImageGen available. No OpenAI API key is required.
image_workflow.executor_required: Connect a Codex agent to this workflow. A leader or design specialist can execute it as long as its provider is Codex.

image_workflow.error_prompt: Add a creative direction before generating.
image_workflow.error_executor_missing: Connect a Codex agent to execute this workflow.
image_workflow.error_executor_offline: Start or resume the connected Codex terminal before generating.
image_workflow.error_executor_unauthoriz: Only the connected Codex executor can operate this run.

image_workflow.error_reference_missing: A connected image does not have a file yet.
image_workflow.error_reference_unavailab: A connected reference file could not be read.
image_workflow.error_reference_size: A reference exceeds the 20 MB limit.
image_workflow.error_reference_total: The references exceed the 80 MB combined limit.
image_workflow.error_reference_count: Connect no more than five reference images.
image_workflow.error_reference_format: References must be valid PNG, JPEG, or WebP files.

image_workflow.error_output_missing: Codex did not copy every generated file to its assigned workspace path.

image_workflow.error_generic: The image could not be generated. Review the inputs and try again.
